questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: The diagram shows some information about carbohydrates. Which carbohydrate is present in cow's milk?
questions.explanation: Lactose is the sugar present in milk

questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: The diagram shows some information about carbohydrates. Which carbohydrate contains only glucose subunits?
questions.explanation: Maltose is composed of two glucose units

questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: The diagram shows some information about carbohydrates. Which carbohydrate is an energy store in animals?
questions.explanation: Glycogen is the storage carbohydrate in animals

questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: The diagram shows some information about carbohydrates. Which carbohydrate has 1-6 glycosidic bonds present?
questions.explanation: Amylopectin has both 1-4 and 1-6 glycosidic bonds

questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: The diagram shows the human heart. Draw arrows on the diagram to show the flow of blood through the left side of the heart and into the aorta.
options: A. Pulmonary vein → left atrium → left ventricle → aorta
B. Vena cava → right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary artery
C. Pulmonary vein → left ventricle → left atrium → aorta
D. Aorta → left ventricle → left atrium → pulmonary vein
questions.explanation: Blood flows from pulmonary vein to left atrium, then left ventricle, then to aorta

questions.subject: as_biology
questions.question: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood to the heart?
questions.explanation: The pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium
